question: Which Animal Handling taming abilities and pet commands do I currently know and which am I missing?
notes: Player-state audit facts verified against the 2026-10-04 CharacterSheet dump: known TameRat (AH bucket) + CharmRat (Unknown bucket — non-skill abilities live there); NOT known: TameBear (Bear Shrine, Kur Mtns, sacrifice 'Perch'), TameCat (Cat Shrine, NE Eltibule, 'String'), TameBee (Crelpin, Fae Realm, AH 70). Live session research -> golden, 2026-10-04.
